overview.description: The Northern Trust ESG & Climate Investment Grade Corporate Core ETF (FEIG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks an index of USD-denominated, investment grade corporate bonds that are screened for ESG characteristics and reduced climate-related risk. FEIG was launched on Sep 20, 2021 and is issued by Northern Trust.
